# IamChinese
**English** | 简体中文
> The product is called **IamChinese**; the package, command and directory are lowercase iamchinese
(npm only takes lowercase names).

`regiongate` had its coordinate system flipped. The default user is now an ordinary person
living in

mainland China: home broadband or 4G egress, `zh-Hans-CN`, `Asia/Shanghai`. North
America and Weste
rn Europe are the ones outside the supported list.

The original build assumed the opposite: Comcast cable, `America/Los_Angeles`, `en-US`, with
`CN` si

tting in `restricted` and a screen that read "your network egress is in CN, this region
is not suppo

in `restricted` and a screen that read "your network egress is in CN, this region
is not supported."
No third-party dependencies. 137 `unittest` cases run offline in about 0.7 s. `plugins/iamchinese/`

holds a
second, dependency-free JavaScript implementation with 81 cases that installs into DeepSeek
Harness or Claude Code as a plugin.

Installed as a plugin, both hosts treat you as a mainland-China user from the first turn:
Simplified

Chinese in the session, dates as `2026-10-21`, money as `¥ CNY`, addresses as
province → city → dis

trict → street, weeks starting Monday. It does not touch your system
locale, your registry, or any t

ool's behaviour, and it does not fake an egress IP. Set
`IAMCHINESE_NO_PROMPT=1` on the DSH side to

turn that off. If you want an actual concrete
persona generated, use the tools below.
## Quick start
[代码示例省略，未执行]
From GitHub:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Or scan the QR code in `plugins/iamchinese/dist/qr.png` — it points at this repository, with the
log

o sitting in the middle (H-level error correction absorbs the hole; `--no-logo` gives you the
plain
black-and-white code). See "Two shells" below for how it is generated.
`--seed` pins the persona (default `20261019`); the same seed reproduces byte-identical output.

Windows consoles default to GBK, where `¥` and CJK characters raise `UnicodeEncodeError`.
`__main__`
forces UTF-8 on stdout/stderr; if your terminal still complains, run `chcp 65001`.

`env.ps1` contains `Set-Culture`, `Set-WinUILanguageOverride` and `tzutil` next to the `$env:`
varia

bles — **dot-sourcing it really does change system settings**. For a shell-only change,
`source ./pr
ofile/env.sh`. `undo` deletes files; it does not roll system settings back.
## Two shells: DSH plugin / Claude Code plugin
`plugins/iamchinese/` is the JavaScript port of the same persona logic. Installed into a host, it is

callable
from inside the session, and it packages up for handing to a friend.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Five tools show up after install: `iamchinese` (generate), `iamchinese_plan` (checklist),
`iamchines

e_apply` (write the three files), `iamchinese_check` (six checks + environment diff),
`iamchinese_sh

are` (export a share bundle), plus a `iamchinese` skill that explains the order to
use them in. On t

he Claude Code side, `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` is the manifest,
`skills/iamchinese/SKILL.md` expl

ains the order, `commands/` adds three slash commands
(persona/apply/share), and the CLI is the same

he order, `commands/` adds three slash commands
(persona/apply/share), and the CLI is the same file.

The QR codes are generated in this package (`scripts/lib/qr.js` — versions 1–6, byte mode, ECC
M/Q,

no dependencies). The default target is this repository, so a code you hand out keeps
working on som
eone else's machine:

`assets/qr-repo.png` is that code, committed; `npm run qr` redraws it,
`node scripts/share-qr.mjs --

url https://your.domain/` points it elsewhere.
`npm run share` serves a LAN page whose own code targ

ets the current interface address — that is
the one for handing a tarball to someone in the same roo

m (`--lan` reproduces it on the command
line). Decodability is checked against OpenCV's decoder by `

scripts/verify-qr.py`: 12 boundary
cases across six versions and two ECC levels, all decoded byte-id

entical; `--png <file>
--expect <url>` verifies a single image.
`plugins/iamchinese/README.md` covers install, uninstall, sharing and "what it does not do". The two

implementations **do not share seed semantics**: one seed gives different personas in the Python
an
d JS versions. To line them up, pass the full profile instead.
### Distributing it
| Path | Command |

| DSH plugin, from npm | `dsh plugin --profile web add iamchinese` |
| DSH plugin, from the release
asset | `dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/lirenjie95/IamChinese/releases/latest/downl

oad/iamchinese-0.3.0.tgz` |
| DSH plugin, from a local tarball | `dsh plugin --profile web add .\dis

t\iamchinese-0.3.0.tgz` |
| Claude Code, this repo as a marketplace | `claude plugin marketplace add

lirenjie95/IamChinese` then `claude plugin install iamchinese@iamchinese` |
[该节后续省略]
## Why the persona is not made up
What gets past a coarse filter is not "the name sounds Chinese" but **six fields that interlock**:
| Check | Why it matters | Implementation |
| locale ↔ time zone | `zh-Hans-CN` with `America/Los_Angeles` is the classic tell | `LOCALE_BCP47`

/ `TIMEZONE` |
| ID region code ↔ shipping address | The first six digits must match province and ci

ty | `_REGIONS`: 28 real province/city/district codes |
| Sequence digit ↔ sex | Digit 17 encodes se

x by parity; flip it and the whole card is wrong | `make_id_card(..., male=…)` |
| Phone prefix ↔ ca
rrier | 155 is Unicom, 139 is Mobile; mixing them is a mismatch | `CARRIERS`, each with real prefixe

s |
| Prefix ↔ ASN | Residential egress ASN must match the carrier | Mobile AS9808 / Unicom AS4837 /

Telecom AS4134 |
| Number length | 11 digits; one short and it is obviously wrong | `consistency()`

elecom AS4134 |
| Number length | 11 digits; one short and it is obviously wrong | `consistency()` |

The 18th digit is computed for real with GB 11643 MOD 11-2 (`id_check_digit()`). A unit test
pins th

e official sample `11010519491231002X` and asserts that changing any single digit breaks
the checksu

m. Egress IP comes from TEST-NET-3 (`203.0.113.0/24`), so nobody mistakes it for a
live host and sta

comes from TEST-NET-3 (`203.0.113.0/24`), so nobody mistakes it for a
live host and starts scanning.
